non_goals: No product-category expansion, unbounded inference, automatic correction or undocumented fallback. Research candidates do not enter production in this task unless explicitly assigned and reviewed.
acceptance_criteria: Frozen install succeeds twice from a clean checkout
action/OCI revisions are immutable and recorded.
commands: python scripts/check_dependencies.py --frozen && python -m unittest discover -s tests/build -v
failure_behavior: Classify failure and preserve completed evidence. Do not relax contract, skip a required profile, fabricate a result or update a baseline to hide it. Report exact blocked capability and continue unrelated ready work.
rollback: Coordinator only: Revert this task’s commits on the integration branch; invalidate dependent evidence, preserve experiment receipts and originals. No destructive cleanup outside assigned worktree.
plan_mismatch: Create docs/proposals/T02.md with observed source, minimal reproducer, affected contracts/tasks/tests and recommended correction. Pause only affected work. Contract owner and integrator decide, update canonical records, then rebase consumers.
required_updates: Submit the T02 state transition and evidence paths to the coordinator; only the state owner changes Beads acceptance state.
